test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following initiatives did the Maharashtra Government approve in September 2025 to generate employment in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities and boost skilled job opportunities?

options.text: Free Urban Transit Support Scheme for job seekers
Targeted Wage Subsidy Programme for unskilled labourers
Global Capability Center policy to expand centres across the state
Mandatory Local Employment Reservation framework in enterprises

solution:
The correct answer is __**Global Capability Center policy to expand centres across the state**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Maharashtra Government**, in **September 2025**, approved the **Global Capability Center (GCC) Policy** to position the state as a leading destination for high-value technical and administrative operations.
 
• The policy specifically targets the development of **Tier-2** and **Tier-3** cities like **Nagpur**, **Nashik**, **Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, and **Pune** to decentralize industrial growth away from the saturated **Mumbai** Metropolitan Region. ***Hence, the correct answer is Global Capability Center policy to expand centres across the state.***
 
• The initiative aims to generate approximately **1 million (10 lakh)** high-skilled jobs by the year **2030**, focusing on **knowledge-based industries**.
 
• Under this policy, the state offers significant incentives, including **stamp duty exemptions**, **electricity duty waivers**, and **investment subsidies** to multinational corporations (MNCs) setting up their centers of excellence.
 
• The focus of these centers will be on cutting-edge technologies such as **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, **Machine Learning (ML)**, **Data Analytics**, and **Blockchain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Understanding Global Capability Centers (GCCs)**: 
 
 
• **GCCs** are offshore units established by **multinational corporations** to handle specialized tasks including **Research and Development (R&D)**, **IT support**, and **Finance/HR operations**.
 
• India has evolved from being a "back-office" hub to a "global innovation hub," currently housing over **1,600 GCCs** that contribute significantly to the **GDP**.
 
 
 
• **Economic Significance**: 
 
 
• The **GCC sector** in India is projected to reach a market size of **$110 billion** by **2030**.
 
• Maharashtra’s policy is a strategic move to capture a lion's share of this market, contributing to India’s goal of becoming a **$5 trillion economy**.
 
 
 
• **Urban Development**: 
 
 
• By focusing on **Tier-2** and **Tier-3** cities, the government aims to improve **infrastructure**, **real estate**, and the **local service economy** in these regions.
 
• This shift helps in reducing the **cost of operations** for companies while providing **local employment** to graduates within their home districts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Skill Integration**: The policy involves collaboration with the **Maharashtra State Skill Development Society (MSSDS)** to create a curriculum tailored to the specific needs of **GCCs**.
 
• **Plug-and-Play Facilities**: To attract fast-paced investments, the state is developing **IT parks** and **Knowledge Parks** with **plug-and-play** infrastructure, allowing companies to start operations immediately.
 
• **Sustainability**: The policy encourages **green building** practices and the use of **renewable energy** within these new capability centers to align with **ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance)** goals.
 
• **Single-Window Clearance**: To improve the **Ease of Doing Business**, a dedicated cell has been established to provide **single-window clearances** for all regulatory requirements related to **GCCs**.
